# Scout Pioneer Challenge: Pioneers of the Wilderness: All Rewards and Challenges

The **Boy Scout Pioneer Challenge: Pioneers of the Wilderness** event is again a challenge event as we already know it. Over a period of 2 weeks, you can complete a series of challenges alongside the daily and weekly challenges and receive rewards in week 1 and week 2. The challenges can usually be completed on the first day of the week.

Current event date:

All challenges require you to wear certain clothing. In this case, you're wearing the **T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit**. You will receive this outfit from August 6th. - August 19, 2024 **free** in the **Atom Shop**.

##Challenges

Event challenges:

Week 1:

- Wilderness Pioneers: Take a photo of a "Lost One" with your camera wearing the T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: 1 Boy Scout Banner*
- Wilderness Pioneers: Take a photo with your camera at the Slumber Mill Motel wearing the Marshal Mallow t-shirt and shorts outfit. *Reward: 3 Lunch Boxes*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Build a C.A.M.P. in the Skyline Valley region wearing the T-Shirt and Shorts Marshal Mallow outfit*Reward: 3 Legendary Modules*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Collect purified water in the T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: Nuka-Cola Mix Pack*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Cook a meal in your C.A.M.P. wearing the T-Shirt and Shorts Marshal Mallow outfit.*Reward: 3 Skill Card Packs*

Week 2:

- Wilderness Pioneers: Take a photo of "Johnson's Field" with your camera wearing the T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: 3 Lunch Boxes*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Take a photo of an ant with your camera wearing the T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: 1 Boy Scout Banner*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Collect a RadAway in the T-Shirt and Shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: Nuka-Cola Mix Pack*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Eat a cooked meal in the T-shirt and shorts Marshal Mallow outfit.*Reward: 3 Legendary Modules*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Kill a Thresher in the T-Shirt and Shorts Marshal Mallow outfit. *Reward: 3 Basic Repair Kits*

Event Challenges (Week 1&2):

- Pioneers of the Wild: Complete Week 1 Challenges. (5)*Reward: "I'd rather be camping now" poster*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Complete Week 2 Challenges. (5)*Reward: Marshal Mallow Figure*
- Pioneers of the Wild: Complete Week 1 and Week 2 Challenges.*Reward: Marshal Mallow Skewer*

## Rewards

### "I'd rather be camping right now" poster

### Marshal Mallow figure

### Marshal Mallow Skewer

The Marshal Mallow Skewer is a paint job for all one-handed melee weapons.
